about.block.title: More About Me
about.page.heading: About
about.page.summary.lead:
I've been working in software for over 05 years now. I enjoy solving problems (in general but mostly using software), making things, and growing teams. I've worked with many different software systems and really enjoy evolving them over time to meet changing needs. I've also done a lot of work on scaling - both increasing throughput and creating processes and automation to make changes safer as the user base grows.
Outside of work, I have a passion for plants (especially bonsai) and crafting wooden furniture for my home.

 Whew, that’s a lot, but I’m genuinely excited to meet everyone and collaborate with new partners!

about.page.otherExperience.heading: Other experience
ConvosoCTIAdapter (Salesforce CTI Managed Package — for Convoso)
Developed and maintained ConvosoCTIAdapter, a production-grade Salesforce Second-Generation Managed Package (2GP) integrating Convoso's telephony system with Salesforce CRM through 400+ Apex classes.

Designed and implemented Queueable/Scheduled Apex jobs with job-locking mechanisms to prevent duplicate execution, along with a publish/subscribe mechanism via Platform Events and Apex triggers to synchronize telephony events in real time.

Built 69 Lightning Web Components, including a multi-tab softphone widget integrated into the Salesforce Utility Bar, using Lightning Message Service for cross-component communication and OAuth 2.0/Named Credentials for external system integration.
Enforced security best practices: CRUD/FLS enforcement, passed Checkmarx SAST and Code Analyzer (PMD, ESLint) scans.

Owned full-stack development of Poppy, a high-traffic marketplace platform connecting couples with local floral designers for wedding planning, built with React.js and Node.js, with the backend progressively migrated to NestJS, including AWS serverless components and PostgreSQL.

Architected and implemented RESTful APIs and asynchronous backend services using AWS serverless (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS, API Gateway); handled high-concurrency scenarios via backend caching strategies and SQS-based service decoupling for asynchronous background processing.
Improved system performance and response times by optimizing TypeORM/Prisma queries and PostgreSQL indexing as data volume scaled.

Built and maintained a shared, reusable React component library across products, improving UI consistency and reusability; simplified complex frontend state management by integrating Zustand, Redux, and Immer.
Integrated third-party services — Stripe, Plaid, SendGrid, OpenAI — into core marketplace workflows (e.g., payments, notifications, and design-matching features), reducing manual processing overhead.
Also contributed to several smaller internal projects using Vue.js and Next.js, within an Agile/Scrum team structure.
about.page.experience.hdwebsoft.tech.tec: React.js, Vue.js, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Systems Manager Parameter Store), PostgreSQL, MySQL, TypeORM, Prisma, Redux, Zustand, Immer, Salesforce (Apex, LWC, Platform Events, 2GP), Stripe, Plaid, SendGrid, OpenAI, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git.
Owned full-stack development of FidoBox, an e-commerce marketplace app that reached Top 5 most-downloaded shopping apps in Vietnam within 5 months of launch, built with React (Vite) on web and React Native/Flutter on mobile, backed by Spring Boot REST APIs.

Designed and implemented core commerce services — product discovery/search, product detail with ratings/reviews, cart/checkout, order management, and a loyalty-points/coupon system — while optimizing PostgreSQL performance through execution-plan analysis and targeted indexing as transaction volume scaled.

Built gamified retention features, including a promotional treasure-hunt mini-game and coupon-hunting flow, alongside an in-app chat and notification system connecting buyers with sellers and support.

Implemented supplier/vendor and affiliate (CTV) onboarding workflows powering the multi-brand marketplace (partners including Xiaomi, Samsung, Nintendo, Asus), plus cross-border ordering and product-authenticity verification logic.
Refactored legacy cart/checkout modules to improve performance and reduce production bugs as the platform scaled.

Managed and optimized production infrastructure on AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda), established CI/CD pipelines via Jenkins and Bitbucket, integrated secure payment gateways, and enforced RESTful API design with CRUD/data-access controls on the PostgreSQL data layer.

Owned full-stack development of FidoVN, a dual-vertical platform combining AI/Big-Data-powered job recruitment with real estate search, reaching 120,000+ users, 10,000+ businesses, and 2,000+ brokers within 8 months of launch.
Built candidate- and employer-facing job marketplace flows (search, job posting management, application tracking) alongside an AI-assisted CV builder and a big-data-driven job-recommendation feed.
Implemented in-app video-interview scheduling and calling between candidates and recruiters, and built a knowledge-library hub (courses and podcasts) for career-skill development.

Implemented an interactive property loan/mortgage estimation tool computing equity, principal, interest, and monthly payment in real time, and integrated a 360° VR viewer for remote property walkthroughs.
Built map-based property search with a verified listing badge system, in-app landlord-tenant calling/messaging, and listing-management/tracking tools for owners and brokers.
Implemented multi-language (i18n) support across web and mobile, and integrated third-party services such as SMS verification and map/geolocation into core account and search workflows.

Across both platforms, applied OOP principles and design patterns consistently on the Java/Spring Boot backend and JavaScript/TypeScript frontend, working across Linux (Ubuntu) production servers and Windows development environments; led architecture design sessions, conducted code reviews, and mentored junior developers within an Agile/Scrum workflow (sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives), using Git and Jira for version control and task tracking.
about.page.experience.toyar.tech: React.js, Vite, React Native, Flutter, JavaScript, Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda), Jenkins, Bitbucket, Datadog, CI/CD, Git, Jira.
about.page.experience.optoro.responsibil: Developed and enhanced features across Optoro's core product using Ruby on Rails, AngularJS, CoffeeScript, and JavaScript. Implemented new functionality, fixed bugs, and refactored legacy code to improve maintainability and performance.
Participated in code reviews and collaborated with team members to maintain code quality before deployment to production. Deployed code changes to production, following established release processes.
Built internal tools and scripts to improve development workflow and team efficiency. Collaborated with product and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
Worked within a Git-based version control workflow, contributing to a shared codebase across multiple contributors.
about.page.experience.optoro.tech: Ruby on Rails, AngularJS, CoffeeScript, JavaScript, Git, HTML, CSS
about.page.experience.mindx.responsibili: Taught full-stack web development (React, Node.js, Next.js, React Native) to students and delivered technical workshops across multiple branches.
Mentored and managed 50+ instructors, contributing to curriculum design and training quality improvement.

testimonials.block.title: Testimonials
testimonials.block.footer: Feedback from people I've worked with.
testimonials.block.items.0.name: Joshua Calducchi
testimonials.block.items.0.body:
Mr.Hieu is a reliable engineer who consistently delivers clear value throughout his work. He maintains strong performance, contributes positively to product quality, and has made a lasting impact on the team - even before I joined Poppy.
I truly appreciate everything Hieu has contributed, especially his support during my early days on the team. I'd be happy to be a reference if that's ever helpful, and I look forward to the opportunity to collaborate with him again on future projects.
testimonials.block.items.1.name: Katherine Patton
testimonials.block.items.1.body: Mr. Hieu is a dependable engineer who consistently brings clarity and impact to his work. His positive attitude and collaborative mindset make him a pleasure to work with across teams. He approaches challenges with a solutions-first mindset, maintains strong delivery standards, and contributes to improving efficiency. His ability to balance quality and speed has been valuable on critical projects, and his proactive support has positively influenced both team performance and overall outcomes.
testimonials.block.items.2.name: Dat Giang
testimonials.block.items.2.body: Hieu demonstrates a high level of ownership and professionalism in everything he does. Beyond his technical capabilities, his proactive communication and willingness to support others stand out. He brings a calm, constructive energy to the team, even under pressure, and consistently delivers results that align with business goals. His contributions have had a meaningful impact on both product stability and team culture. He also takes initiative in solving problems early and helps guide teammates toward better outcomes overall consistently.
testimonials.block.items.3.name: Matthew Zhao
testimonials.block.items.3.body: Working with Hieu has been a seamless experience. He is highly responsive, detail-oriented, and always ensures that requirements are clearly understood before execution. His positive and can-do attitude helps drive momentum within the team. He not only meets expectations but often goes the extra mile to suggest improvements that enhance user experience and product value. Additionally, he communicates effectively with stakeholders and contributes to smoother collaboration across teams consistently.
testimonials.block.items.4.name: Benjamin Papillon
testimonials.block.items.4.body:
Hieu was my first engineering hire, and we began discussing working together just weeks after I incorporated the business in the summer of 2021. He built our first website and many critical systems that followed. 
 He has been an incredibly adaptable colleague, partner, and friend. I cannot imagine taking the company from pre-revenue to post Series A without him. We have grown the business nationally and overcome countless challenges together and have delivered results while maintaining strong team culture.
testimonials.block.items.5.name: Nico Martinez
testimonials.block.items.5.body: Hieu combines technical competence with a great team spirit. He is enthusiastic, open to feedback, and continuously seeks ways to improve both his skills and the systems he works on. His structured approach to problem-solving and attention to detail help ensure robust and maintainable solutions. I truly value his contributions and look forward to collaborating with him again on future initiatives while continuing to grow together and deliver strong outcomes across diverse projects and evolving team environments over time.
testimonials.block.items.6.name: Daniel Bailey
testimonials.block.items.6.body: Hieu, it's been a real pleasure getting to know you and working alongside you. You're not only a talented engineer and strong leader, but also an exceptional person. Your mission focus and loyalty to the cause are truly admirable. I'm grateful for the time we've shared and look forward to staying connected. Wishing you all the best on this exciting new chapter ahead, and continued success in everything you pursue moving forward. I appreciate your impact and support always.

projects.page.title: All Projects
project.walkerip.description: Walker IP is an Australian intellectual property law firm providing patent, trademark, and industrial design registration services for startups and large enterprises. Specializing in engineering, technology, biotechnology, and medical device innovations, the firm guides clients through complex IP processes with expert legal counsel to protect and commercialize their innovations effectively.
project.flightlocal.description: Flight Local is a B2B travel portal built exclusively for travel agencies, enabling seamless booking of flights, hotels, holiday packages, and visas. The platform features booking queue management, real-time reporting, payment processing, and markup configuration tools, helping agencies streamline operations and deliver faster, more efficient service to their customers.
project.tapy.description: Tapy is a mobile marketing application designed for small businesses to boost sales through personalized promotions delivered directly to existing customers. Achieving engagement rates up to 10x higher than email and 7.2x higher than traditional social media, Tapy helps local businesses build loyalty, increase repeat purchases, and grow revenue with minimal marketing effort.
project.khora.description: Khora is a Spanish urban consulting company tackling city development challenges through a creative process of discovery, experimentation, and scaling innovative solutions. With a mission to build smarter, more sustainable, and better-connected cities, Khora collaborates with governments and organizations to design urban strategies that improve quality of life for communities.
project.granada.description: AI Lab Granada is Spain's premier AI innovation hub, offering a collaborative platform that connects medium and large enterprises with top AI talent, cutting-edge technologies, and applied research. The lab helps organizations improve operational efficiency, accelerate digital transformation, and drive sustainable growth through customized artificial intelligence solutions and innovation partnerships.
project.travel.description: Tryotel Mobile App is a B2C travel application enabling users to search and book flights, hotels, and holiday packages directly from their mobile devices. Built with clean material design and intuitive multi-layer navigation, the app is tailored for young, active travelers seeking a fast, seamless, and visually engaging travel booking experience on the go.
project.tryotel.description: Tryotel is a Bangladesh-based B2C travel platform enabling users to book flights, holiday packages, visas, and hotels online with ease. The platform integrates promotional campaigns, multiple payment methods, and cross-platform mobile applications, delivering a comprehensive and convenient travel planning experience for customers across Bangladesh and international destinations.
project.thought.description: A Higher Thought is an online inspiration platform offering motivational videos, memes, articles, and positive lifestyle products to uplift and encourage its community. Users can freely explore, save, and share content across social media channels, spreading positivity and meaningful messages that inspire personal growth and bring encouragement to people around the world.
project.poppy.description: Poppy is a wedding floral service platform that empowers couples to browse floral collections, build fully customized wedding flower proposals, and receive transparent pricing upfront. The platform handles end-to-end floral services including professional design consultation, delivery, and on-site setup, making the process of creating a beautiful, stress-free wedding floral experience simple and enjoyable.
project.fidovn.description: Fido.vn is a Vietnamese online recruitment platform connecting job seekers with employers through intelligent job posting and CV search systems. Tailored for Gen Z professionals, it features an AI-powered CV builder that automatically generates polished, professional resumes, helping young candidates stand out and find suitable career opportunities faster in a competitive job market.
project.multiangle.description: Multiangle AI is a cutting-edge artificial intelligence platform empowering businesses with advanced analytics, automation, and machine learning capabilities. Designed to accelerate innovation and sustainable growth, the platform provides organizations with intelligent tools and data-driven insights to streamline operations, uncover opportunities, and make smarter strategic decisions in an increasingly competitive digital landscape.
project.tattoo.description: The Thế Trung Tattoo is a professional tattoo studio website showcasing custom tattoo services, detailed artwork collections, transparent pricing, and the complete tattooing process. Clients can explore the studio's portfolio, read genuine customer reviews, and conveniently book online consultations to discuss their ideas and receive high-quality, personalized tattoo experiences from skilled artists.
project.baby.description: BabyQuip is a baby gear rental platform connecting traveling families with trusted local providers across thousands of locations. All equipment including cribs, strollers, and car seats is delivered to your accommodation, thoroughly cleaned, and safety-checked before every rental. The platform also offers party rentals and professional baby gear cleaning services for added convenience.
project.signinapp.description: Sign In App is a smart visitor and workplace management platform that seamlessly combines visitor check-in, employee sign-in, room booking, and emergency response into one connected system. Trusted by over 25,000 locations worldwide and certified ISO 27001, GDPR, and HIPAA compliant, it helps organizations of all sizes manage access, safety, and workplace experience effortlessly.
project.singlekey.description: SingleKey is a comprehensive rental risk management platform built for Canadian landlords. It provides thorough tenant screening with credit and background checks, automated monthly rent collection, and income guarantee protection covering up to $60,000 in unpaid rent, $10,000 in property damage, and $2,000 in eviction legal fees, giving landlords complete peace of mind.
project.swipedon.description: SwipedOn is an employee and workspace management software trusted by over 9,000 workplaces globally. It tracks staff check-ins, supports hybrid work arrangements, and enables easy desk and meeting room bookings from any device. Currently merging with Sign In App, SwipedOn is evolving into a next-generation unified platform for smarter, safer workplace management.
